selection_policy: Separate source-backed LLM pre-tokenization workloads, selected from regexr examples and verified against current tiktoken production patterns before timing. Kept outside the earlier production aggregate.
output_contract: Every non-overlapping match as a UTF-8 byte span; no BPE token IDs.

cases.scope: Non-overlapping UTF-8 spans from tiktoken cl100k_base regex pre-tokenization; excludes BPE merges, vocabulary lookup, special-token handling and whole-model tokenization.
cases.oracle_runtime: Python regex 2026.1.15; original pattern; complete match spans retained.
adaptations: Replace the bounded possessive \p{N}{1,3}+ with the equivalent atomic group (?>\p{N}{1,3}) for Oniguruma-family syntax. Its default dialect otherwise parses the trailing + as another repetition. Preserve all other source constructs and match spans.
Enable Unicode shorthand classes in PCRE2; preserve Unicode properties and inline case options.
Use native whole-match iteration where available, preserving every match span without requesting subgroup capture output.
